answer: Identity starts as a parcel: enrolment mails a sealed token to a validated dwelling address, and the wake code is printed inside the wrapping, so nothing signs until it arrives. Each epoch the ledger wants that serial beside the signature; a device moved to a second address retires the first. The address register rejects mail drops, so one letterbox backs one miner. A thousand clones need a thousand households: 1,000 tokens at $38 plus $14 postage, near $52,000 and six days of delivery before a fable pays. A mirror hangs in a minute; the pigment is cheap, the wall behind is not.
